entities.summary: Pierre Boutang was a French philosopher, poet and translator. He was also a political journalist, associated with the currents of Maurrasianism and Royalism. Pierre Boutang was a philosophers & thinkers from Saint-Étienne (1916-09-20, Saint-Étienne–1998-06-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
